title: Private housekeeping & ironing
summary: Dedicated, recurring housekeeping staff for laundry, ironing, wardrobe care and the running of your home.

meta.title: Private housekeeping and ironing in Luxembourg
meta.description: Dedicated housekeepers for private residences in Luxembourg: cleaning, laundry, ironing, wardrobe care and the day-to-day running of your home.

hero.intro: A dedicated housekeeper who knows your home, your preferences and your routines. Discreet, reliable and supported by a supervisor who keeps standards consistent.

image.alt: Neatly pressed shirts hanging in a well-ordered dressing room

included.intro: Housekeeping is defined together, task by task, and recorded in a household handbook your housekeeper follows.

groups.title: Laundry and wardrobe

faq.question: Is the housekeeper employed by you or by me?
faq.answer: By us. We handle recruitment, contracts, social security, training, insurance and absence cover. You receive one clear invoice.

faq.question: Can I meet the housekeeper before they start?
faq.answer: Yes. We introduce your proposed housekeeper and, if the match is not right, we propose someone else.

faq.question: Do your housekeepers sign a confidentiality agreement?
faq.answer: Yes. Every member of staff signs a confidentiality agreement, and we can sign an additional agreement with you if required.

faq.question: Which languages do your housekeepers speak?
faq.answer: Our team speaks a range of languages, including French, Portuguese, German, Luxembourgish and English. Tell us your preference and we will match accordingly.
